title: A bug in a callee introduces the unit law's contradiction through the contradicting record's cone (refs), though Req is unchanged; an edit outside the cone leaves it preexisting

assert.why: A.7.3.3 [D4]: Req (total@unit) did not move, but the cone of the contradicting record (total closed under Refs°, reaching round) meets Δcode at the edited callee, so the sound contradiction is introduced; no base-revision record made it, so the counterexample clause does not apply
A.7.1.5: the sound contradiction suppresses unestablished
A.7.3.3: neither Req nor the contradicting record's cone (total, round) meets Δcode (only other.ts changed), so the contradiction is preexisting
